title: Pre-Orders & Back-Orders: Marlowe Rewards Points Reduction on Made-to-Order Remake Deposits
content:
Marlowe Rewards points earned on orders and posted in the last 12 months take percentage points off the remake deposit percentage of a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Made-to-Order remake, before that percentage is applied to the price.

| Points earned on orders and posted, last 12 months | Percentage points off |
|---|---|
| 4000 or more | 3 |
| 1500 up to fewer than 4000 | 1 |
| Fewer than 1500 | 0 |

**What is counted.** The entries on the customer's Marlowe Rewards points ledger for points earned on orders, each taken by its posting date. Only entries posted within the last 12 months count. Their points are added together.

**Edges of the bands**

| Points | Points off |
|---|---|
| 1499 | 0 |
| 1500 | 1 |
| 3999 | 1 |
| 4000 | 3 |

**Example (hypothetical member).** Over the last 12 months the ledger shows earning entries of 1800, 1250 and 1100 points, a total of 4150. That total is 4000 or more, so 3 percentage points come off the remake deposit percentage. An earning entry posted 14 months ago is outside the 12 months and is not counted.
